reproduction_procedure: Inspect pipeline.py:182-222. Variable fwd_model is read from meta, but line 222 calls simulate_diffraction unconditionally. F3, F4, F5, F6 models in models/ are never called in generation.
expected_behavior: When profile defines forward_model in {F1..F6}, simulate_forward_model must route execution to the respective model implementation.
actual_behavior: All profiles execute standard Fraunhofer diffraction (simulate_diffraction), leaving forward_model as metadata only.
scientific_consequences: Synthetic observations labeled as Fresnel near-field, aberrated probe, polychromatic, or 3D particles are identical to conventional Fraunhofer diffraction.
proposed_remedy: Implement simulate_forward_model dispatcher in physics/forward.py and invoke it from simulate_single_task.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect forward.py:240-249. observed_masked is computed as intensity_measured * mask, but returned and stored field is unmasked intensity_measured. Learning models see pixels behind beamstops and gaps.
expected_behavior: Inaccessible detector regions (beamstop, module gaps, dead pixels) must contain 0 in observed input array intensity_observed, while unmasked detector readout is stored separately as intensity_raw.
actual_behavior: intensity_measured contains non-zero unmasked simulated intensity behind beamstops and detector gaps.
scientific_consequences: Severe information leakage: inverse solvers and neural networks trained on this dataset receive true diffraction signals in physically inaccessible regions.
proposed_remedy: Standardize fields: intensity_raw (full detector readout before mask) and intensity_observed (masked with exact zeros outside valid_mask). Add backward compatibility alias.

reproduction_procedure: Run simulate_fresnel_diffraction with propagation_distance_m=0.0. Inspect output field: fftshift is erroneously applied to propagated real-space field.
expected_behavior: At z = 0, propagated field should be identical to input_field (within numerical float precision).
actual_behavior: At z = 0, real-space object is translated by (N/2, N/2) due to spurious fftshift on real-space field after ifft2.
scientific_consequences: Fresnel model inverts coordinate space and breaks boundary conditions and spatial alignment.
proposed_remedy: Remove erroneous fftshift on spatial field in fresnel.py, verify band-limited ASM cutoff, and test zero-distance identity.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect torch_dataset.py:176-188. When intensity_expected is absent from compact shard, fallback code sets clean_arr = inp_arr and returns noisy measurement as target.
expected_behavior: Loaders must raise descriptive KeyError or ValueError when a required supervised ground-truth target is missing, unless explicitly configured for self-supervised mode.
actual_behavior: Silently substitutes noisy measurement as its own clean target in denoising and inpainting tasks.
scientific_consequences: Models train to predict noise as clean signal; benchmark evaluations measure identity reproduction instead of true restoration.
proposed_remedy: Raise explicit error when clean target is requested but absent; provide deterministic target generation or companion target shards.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect phase_retrieval.py:58-62. HIO and ER algorithms replace all Fourier amplitudes with measured modulus, including zeroed masked pixels. Fourier residual formula computes squared error divided by sum of squares.
expected_behavior: Masked/inaccessible Fourier pixels must remain unconstrained or updated iteratively. Classical R-factor must be sum(|G| - |F|) / sum(|F|) over valid pixels.
actual_behavior: Algorithms force Fourier modulus to 0 at masked pixels, creating severe non-physical artifacts. Reported R-factor is normalized squared error.
scientific_consequences: Classical baseline performance drops artificially to SSIM ~ 0.0128, leading to false claims about classical CDI failure.
proposed_remedy: Implement mask-aware Fourier projection, align reconstructions (translation, twin image, phase) before evaluation, and report true R-factor.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect pipeline.py:225. A holder arm with random orientation is injected whenever acq_idx == 2, even if profile does not specify holder arm.
expected_behavior: Detector geometry and masks must be driven deterministically by profile metadata and configuration.
actual_behavior: Spurious holder arm added to acquisition index 2 without metadata documentation.
scientific_consequences: Acquisition variation is confounded with undocumented detector geometry changes.
proposed_remedy: Decouple holder arm injection from acquisition index and make it strictly profile-driven.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect pipeline.py:276-278. Wavelength, pixel pitch, and distance are hardcoded constants (1.24e-10, 7.5e-5, 0.5) in manifest regardless of scenario.
expected_behavior: Manifest records the physical parameters corresponding to the active scenario or profile configuration.
actual_behavior: Manifest records fixed constants regardless of scenario S1-S6 or optical vs X-ray regime.
scientific_consequences: Users cannot trust metadata for quantitative inverse problem reconstruction or physical scaling.
proposed_remedy: Populate manifest parameters directly from the resolved DiffractionConfig.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect pipeline.py:383-401. Entire shard of 480 samples (multiple 512x512 arrays per sample) is held in memory before write_shard_atomic is called.
expected_behavior: Streaming or chunked incremental writing to bounded temporary file, keeping peak memory under resource threshold.
actual_behavior: High peak memory (over 2 GiB per shard) causing out-of-memory risks on memory-constrained systems.
scientific_consequences: Crash risk during generation on standard CPU environments.
proposed_remedy: Write samples incrementally to chunked HDF5 datasets and finalize atomically.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect storage.py:81. verify_shard only checks row count and basic keys. It does not check configuration hash, random seed, or file integrity checksum.
expected_behavior: Resume validation must verify config hash and dataset integrity before marking shard as complete.
actual_behavior: Stale or incompatible shards with identical sample count are reused silently.
scientific_consequences: Silent data corruption when resuming with modified parameters or seeds.
proposed_remedy: Store configuration fingerprint and per-shard checksum in HDF5 root attributes and check during resume.

reproduction_procedure: Inspect pipeline.py:178. total=1000 is hardcoded in sample_profile_48 call regardless of requested total_samples.
expected_behavior: total parameter passed to sample_profile_48 should reflect actual number of base objects planned.
actual_behavior: Fixed constant total=1000 passed even for quick or smoke test runs with 48 samples.
scientific_consequences: Inconsistent sampling strides across small and large dataset presets.
proposed_remedy: Pass actual number of unique base objects derived from task plan.
